title: Configuration Manager and Intune Co-Management Enablement
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (project: enable co-management across Configuration Manager + Intune + Entra, move workloads, coexistence/cutover, higher risk).
hook: Bridge Configuration Manager and Intune — move workloads to the cloud at your own pace
problem: You have years of investment in Configuration Manager, but management is moving to the cloud and you can't rip-and-replace overnight. Co-management lets a single Windows device be managed by Configuration Manager and Intune at the same time, so you shift workloads — compliance, updates, endpoint protection, configuration, app deployment — from Configuration Manager to Intune one at a time, on your schedule, with a clean path to cloud-first. This solution enables co-management correctly and gives you a controlled workload-by-workload migration.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — how co-management works, the Configuration Manager + Intune authority model, the co-management workloads (compliance, updates, endpoint protection, device configuration, Office Click-to-Run, client apps), and the staged workload-slider approach.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (supported Configuration Manager current branch, Intune, Entra ID, hybrid or Entra join, Entra Connect, the cloud attach / tenant attach configuration) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: prepare identity and licensing, enable co-management in Configuration Manager, onboard a pilot collection, move one workload at a time to Intune, validate each, then expand and plan cloud-first.

5 PowerShell scripts — co-management readiness discovery, co-management state validation per device, a workload-authority and enrollment report, safe remediation of un-enrolled clients, and a co-management pilot group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: Enable co-management so a single Windows device is managed by Configuration Manager and Intune together — then move workloads to the cloud one at a time, on your schedule. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
short_plain: Enable co-management so Windows devices are managed by Configuration Manager and Intune together — then move workloads to the cloud one at a time, on your schedule.
meta_title: Configuration Manager and Intune Co-Management Enablement
meta_description: Enable Configuration Manager + Intune co-management: cloud/tenant attach, enroll devices, move workloads (compliance, updates, protection, config, apps) to Intune by stages. Self-guided, tested steps and scripts.
bottom_line: Your Configuration Manager fleet co-managed with Intune — workloads moving to the cloud one controlled step at a time, with a clear path to cloud-first — proven on a pilot before you scale.
